name: Apophatic theology

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Cloud of Unknowing which separates the finite intellect from the infinite essence

VINIT.justification: The unconditioned source prior to any predication or conceptual differentiation

TANCH.justification: The final state of union where the soul is contained within the divine presence

AFWD.justification: The positive movement of attributing names and qualities to the divine

AREV.justification: The systematic negation of all attributes to strip away conceptual idols

CLINK.justification: The sequential process of affirming then negating to transcend language

IMSCRIB.justification: The recognition of the self as a reflection of the divine void

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the divine into the perceived attributes of Being and Non-Being

FFUSE.justification: The reconciliation of opposites into the singular reality that transcends both

EVALT.justification: The temporary acceptance of a name as a symbolic pointer

EVALF.justification: The rejection of the name as inadequate to the reality

ENGAGR.justification: The state where light and dark are held as identical in their blinding intensity

IFIX.justification: The permanent cessation of speech once the limit of language is reached

phase_3.void_description: The pre-conceptual silence before the first word is spoken
phase_3.true_description: The kataphatic assertion that God is Good or God is Light
phase_3.false_description: The apophatic denial that God is Good in any human sense
phase_3.both_description: The mystical paradox where God is both everything and nothing

steps.domain_action: The Absolute exists in unmanifested silence
The Absolute recognizes its own undifferentiated nature
The intellect divides the Absolute into subject and object
The intellect affirms the divine as the source of all Being
The soul ascends through the hierarchy of celestial names
The soul chains attributes together to form a theology
The theology is recorded as a temporary doctrinal anchor
The soul begins the descent by stripping away these names
The soul denies that any name captures the divine essence
The tension between affirmation and negation collapses
The soul enters the Divine Darkness where opposites coincide
The soul identifies its own emptiness with the divine void
The experience is fixed in the memory as a point of no return
The soul rests in the finality of the Cloud of Unknowing

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The contemplative faculty which translates scripture into spiritual experience
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The prayer of the heart which communicates without words
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The store of traditional symbols used as rungs on the ladder of ascent
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The liturgical cycle and the stages of the mystical life
phase_5.alfs_store: The Corpus Areopagiticum and the writings of the desert fathers

phase_6.cycle_cost: The exhaustion of language and the surrender of the ego
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A state of conceptual clutter and intellectual pride
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A state of luminous ignorance and spiritual poverty
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The energy spent in affirmation is recovered in negation
